title: Jayden Daniels up to full practice on Wednesday

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Jayden Daniels up to full practice on Wednesday
sources.description: Word last weekend was that Jayden Daniels's practice participation would determine whether he's able to return as the Commanders' starting quarterback against the Giants in Week 5 and Wednesday's injury report offers reason to believe he's moving in the right direction.
